subject: Kickoff: account trajectory, term evolution & QBR invite
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor@nimblepay.com>, Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: account trajectory, term evolution & QBR invite

Hi Taylor / Ruth,

Great to reconnect — thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, I want to kick off a short renewal + expansion cadence to align on:

- term evolution options (12 vs 24 month commit)
- capacity uplift needs for peak payroll season (estimated uplift: +25-40% tokens)
- pricing/discount framing and contracting steps
- QBR scheduling for a product + ops review (we'll come prepared with usage trends and recommendations)

Proposed near-term timeline:
1) This week: confirm QBR window and stakeholders
2) Week of Oct 6: product-led QBR (30–45m) + proposed MAP
3) Week of Oct 13: finalize term amendment and DocuSign

Ask: could you please confirm two preferred QBR slots (one the week of Oct 6, one fallback the week of Oct 13)? Also send the names/emails of any additional stakeholders who should be looped in (security/regulatory if applicable).

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan (NimblePay_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short capacity options summary we'll iterate on. Ben (AE) and Monica (CSM) are on copy and will own the capacity and onboarding details. Logan will review commercial approvals on the leadership side.

If that timeline looks OK I can send a calendar poll and draft MAP update for your review.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: NimblePay_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 page)
From: Taylor Brooks <taylor@nimblepay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@nimblepay.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Kickoff: account trajectory, term evolution & QBR invite

Marissa — thanks, this is perfect.

Quick answers:
- QBR slots: Oct 7 (10:00–10:45 PT) or Oct 14 (11:00–11:45 PT) work best for our execs. If you need a third option, Oct 8 AM is possible.
- Stakeholders: I'll include our Head of Engineering (Ruth), Head of Ops (me), and our procurement lead (Andrew Park — andrew@nimblepay.com) on the final invite.
- Capacity: we are expecting a 30% token increase in November for payroll season and want to discuss a predictable burst plan rather than ad-hoc scaling.

Can you also clarify the SLA/credits language if we move to a 24-month commitment? We may be open to committing longer if we get a clearer availability guarantee.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Brooks
Head of Ops, NimblePay
Cell: +1 720-555-0824

Subject: Re: Kickoff: account trajectory, term evolution & QBR invite

Taylor — appreciate the clarity. A few quick notes on capacity and the 24-month ask: 

- Capacity options: we can offer a baseline commit + burst pool. Baseline covers steady-state usage; burst pool covers seasonal spikes. Example: baseline = 1.0M tokens/day, burst pool = additional 500k tokens/day for up to 30 days. We can size to your November forecast (30% uplift) — see attached Capacity_Options_Q3.pdf with two configurations.
- Pricing/credits: moving to a 24-month committed term unlocks a larger tier discount and a 99.9% availability SLA by contract with a service credit schedule. The legal team will require us to capture the SLA in the term amendment; we can share the standard language but are open to reasonable negotiation for enterprise customers.
- Next step on our side: I'll prepare a baseline vs burst cost table and a recommended MAP update to reflect the uplift scenarios.

I'll aim to share the cost table and updated MAP draft by EOD Friday. If helpful, we can also set a short pre-QBR technical call (15m) to walk the ops/security team through caching/bursting behavior and how we handle KV cache warmup during spikes.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: Capacity_Options_Q3.pdf (3 pages, config outlines)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Brooks <taylor@nimblepay.com>, Ruth Chen <ruth.chen@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-09-29T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: account trajectory, term evolution & QBR invite

Thanks, Taylor — that schedule works. I'm locking in Oct 7, 10:00–10:45 PT for the QBR and sending a calendar invite now (poll closed). If anything changes, we can move to the Oct 14 fallback.

Action items from Redwood before the QBR:
- Ben: deliver baseline vs burst cost table and updated MAP (due EOD Fri) — will include commit/24-mo pricing and SLA language summary.
- Monica: assemble usage dashboard screenshots and top regressions flagged last 30 days.
- Marissa: send calendar invite, pre-read (MAP v1 with notes), and DocuSign link for a draft amendment to review.

Taylor — I'll include Andrew on the next thread when we send the DocuSign draft (procurement path). For the SLA conversation, Logan will be on the call if we need any deviation from standard credit language.

I'll attach the pre-read in the invite; please flag any other stakeholders. Look forward to the QBR.

Best,
Marissa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
